run_observer_mode_client: run the orchestrator client SDK in observer mode with a robot ID flag
connect_orchestrator_helper: connect an OrchestratorHelper client in observer mode and read robot release configs
observe_latest_work_unit: call observe_latest_work_unit to fetch and inspect the latest work unit data
print_work_unit_info: print detailed work unit info including scene details, policy, and success scores
disconnect_orchestrator_client: disconnect the orchestrator client after completing the observer mode loop
